name: Phase U1 — Maersk Design foundation (tokens, fonts, primitives)
goal: Establish a Maersk Design visual foundation in the existing Tailwind setup: brand color tokens, Inter/Fira Code typography, and a small set of reusable UI primitives. Frontend-only (apps/web); the API and the anonymous share-link/name+role flow are NOT touched.
scope_note: This is a Tailwind REPLICA of Maersk Design (no @maersk-global packages — they are not on a reachable registry and would not build on Railway). Palette derived from the live Maersk ALP platform: Maersk Blue #42b0d5, deep blue #00a3e0, steel #b0c4d8, slate #6b7b8d, amber #f0b429; Inter (UI) + Fira Code (mono).

stories.title: Extend Tailwind theme with Maersk Design tokens
stories.description: Edit apps/web/tailwind.config.ts to add a Maersk palette under theme.extend.colors: maersk: { blue:'#42b0d5', 'blue-deep':'#00a3e0', steel:'#b0c4d8', slate:'#6b7b8d', amber:'#f0b429', ink:'#141b25', surface:'#f0f4f8' } and a primary scale aliased to Maersk Blue. Add fontFamily.sans = ['Inter','system-ui','-apple-system','sans-serif'] and fontFamily.mono = ['Fira Code','ui-monospace','monospace']. Add a borderRadius token (e.g. 'mds' = '0.5rem') and a subtle shadow ('mds'). Update apps/web/src/index.css base layer: body bg-maersk-surface text-maersk-ink, and a global focus-visible ring in Maersk Blue. Do NOT change any component markup yet.
stories.completion_notes: Added Maersk palette (blue/blue-deep/steel/slate/amber/ink/surface) + primary scale aliased to Maersk Blue, fontFamily sans=Inter / mono=Fira Code, borderRadius.mds and boxShadow.mds to tailwind.config.ts. index.css base layer sets body bg-maersk-surface/text-maersk-ink/font-sans and a global Maersk Blue focus-visible ring. No component markup changed. check/build/test all green.
acceptance_criteria: tailwind.config.ts defines maersk.blue '#42b0d5', maersk.steel, maersk.slate, maersk.amber and sans=Inter / mono=Fira Code (grep confirms)
index.css base sets the Maersk surface/ink colors and a focus-visible ring

stories.title: Load Inter + Fira Code fonts (self-hosted, offline-safe)
stories.description: Add the Inter and Fira Code webfonts so the build does not depend on a runtime Google Fonts request (Maersk-network friendly). Prefer @fontsource/inter and @fontsource/fira-code (npm) imported in main.tsx, or vendor the woff2 files under apps/web/src/assets/fonts and @font-face them in index.css. Ensure the fonts actually apply (body renders in Inter). Keep bundle reasonable (only needed weights: 400/500/600/700 for Inter, 400 for Fira Code).
acceptance_criteria: Inter and Fira Code are bundled locally (no external fonts.googleapis.com request at runtime)
Computed body font-family resolves to Inter (verify via built CSS / inspection)

stories.title: Create Maersk UI primitives: Button, Card, Input, Badge, Spinner
stories.description: Create apps/web/src/ui/ with small, reusable, typed components styled to Maersk Design: Button (variants: primary=Maersk Blue solid, secondary=steel outline, ghost; sizes sm/md; loading state), Card (white surface, mds radius+shadow, optional header), Input + Textarea + Label (steel border, Maersk Blue focus ring, error state), Badge (status colors: blue/green/amber/slate), Spinner. Export from apps/web/src/ui/index.ts. Add a lightweight cn() class-merge helper (clsx). Do not yet refactor pages to use them (that is U2/U3) — but render them in a tiny throwaway story/test to prove they compile and accept props.
acceptance_criteria: apps/web/src/ui/{Button,Card,Input,Badge,Spinner}.tsx exist and are exported from ui/index.ts
A unit/render test mounts Button (primary+loading) and Badge and asserts they render

name: Phase U2 — App shell, navigation & global states
goal: Redesign the app frame: a Maersk-style header/navbar, a consistent page shell/container, and standardized loading/empty/error states using the new primitives.

stories.title: Maersk-style Navbar + app shell layout
stories.description: Redesign apps/web/src/components/Navbar.tsx into a Maersk header: a top brand bar with the Maersk PRD Studio wordmark next to the 'P' logo mark (served at /pmark.svg in apps/web/public), a Maersk Blue accent (e.g. a thin top border or logo block in #42b0d5), Inter type, and a clean white surface with a subtle bottom border. Create apps/web/src/components/AppShell.tsx providing a max-width container, consistent horizontal padding, and vertical rhythm; wrap the routed pages in it. Keep the existing routes/links working (Home link, etc.).
acceptance_criteria: Navbar renders the brand with a Maersk Blue accent and Inter type; existing Home navigation still works
AppShell wraps pages with a max-width container + consistent padding (used in App.tsx)
[MANUAL] Header visually matches a clean Maersk look at desktop and 375px

stories.title: Standardize loading skeletons, empty states, and error banners
stories.description: Create apps/web/src/components/feedback/{Skeleton,EmptyState,ErrorBanner}.tsx in Maersk style (steel/slate tones, Maersk Blue accents) and a small Toast/inline-status pattern. These replace the ad-hoc gray boxes and raw error text currently used across pages. Do not rewire every page here — just provide the components and use them on at least one page (Home) as the reference implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Skeleton, EmptyState, ErrorBanner components exist and are used on Home
Render test mounts EmptyState and ErrorBanner

name: Phase U3 — Page redesigns (Maersk look + layout)
goal: Restyle and re-layout every page using the new tokens, primitives, and shell. Behaviour and data flow stay identical; only presentation/layout changes. Anonymous join (name+role+mode) is preserved.

stories.title: Home (project list) redesign
stories.description: Rebuild apps/web/src/pages/Home.tsx using Card/Badge/Button and a responsive grid of project cards (name, truncated description, session-count badge, last-updated). Maersk-styled 'New Project' primary button and a polished empty state. Preserve the existing fetch + navigation behaviour.
acceptance_criteria: Home renders a responsive grid of Maersk-styled project cards using the ui primitives
Existing project fetch + 'New Project' navigation still work

stories.title: NewProject form redesign
stories.description: Restyle apps/web/src/pages/NewProject.tsx with the Input/Textarea/Label/Button primitives, a Card-wrapped form, Maersk Blue focus rings, and inline validation styling. Preserve client-side validation, the template/topic fields, the POST, and redirect behaviour.
acceptance_criteria: Form uses the Maersk Input/Button primitives and Card layout; validation + submit + redirect unchanged
[MANUAL] Form reads as a Maersk form (labels, focus rings, spacing)

stories.title: JoinSession landing redesign (keep anonymous name+role+mode)
stories.description: Restyle apps/web/src/pages/JoinSession.tsx: a welcoming Maersk landing card with project context, the name + role (datalist) + interview-mode (standard/guided) form using the primitives. The anonymous flow is unchanged — no login, no accounts. Preserve lookup/resume + create-session behaviour.
acceptance_criteria: Join landing is Maersk-styled; name/role/mode form and existing create/resume behaviour preserved (still anonymous)
[MANUAL] Landing looks polished at 375px and desktop

stories.title: ProjectDashboard redesign + responsive 2-column layout
stories.description: Rebuild apps/web/src/pages/ProjectDashboard.tsx layout: a Maersk header block (name/description/topic), the share-link + copy control restyled, a two-column responsive layout (sessions list + PRD preview), Maersk-styled export buttons, and use of SessionList/PrdPreview. Preserve polling, copy-to-clipboard, export hrefs, and all data behaviour.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard uses a responsive 2-col layout with Maersk styling; polling, copy link, and export still work
[MANUAL] Collapses cleanly to a single column at 375px

stories.title: ChatSession interview UI redesign
stories.description: Restyle apps/web/src/pages/ChatSession.tsx: Maersk chat bubbles (user = Maersk Blue, assistant = white card with a Maersk avatar mark), redesigned coverage progress bars (Maersk Blue fill, steel track), quick-reply chips, typing indicator, and the completion overlay — all using the tokens/primitives. Preserve auto-start (__START__), optimistic send, coverage display, quick-reply, and completion behaviour exactly.
acceptance_criteria: Chat bubbles, coverage bars, quick replies, typing indicator and completion overlay are Maersk-styled
Auto-start, send/typing, coverage, quick-reply and completion behaviour are unchanged
[MANUAL] Chat is usable and clean at 375px and desktop

stories.title: Restyle SessionList + PrdPreview (markdown typography)
stories.description: Restyle apps/web/src/components/SessionList.tsx (Maersk rows + status Badges + relative time) and apps/web/src/components/PrdPreview.tsx (Maersk 'prose'-style markdown: Inter headings, readable measure, steel rules, Fira Code for code blocks). Preserve react-markdown rendering and the empty-state placeholder.
acceptance_criteria: SessionList uses Maersk Badges + rows; PrdPreview renders markdown with Maersk typography (code in Fira Code)

name: Phase U4 — Responsive, accessibility & deploy polish
goal: Final consistency sweep: responsiveness at 375px, accessible focus/contrast, a consistency audit, and confirmation the build is Railway-ready via the existing pipeline.

stories.title: Responsive + accessibility pass across all pages
stories.description: Audit every page at 375px and desktop: ensure full-width layouts collapse cleanly, tap targets are adequate, all interactive elements have visible focus-visible rings (Maersk Blue), color contrast meets WCAG AA against the Maersk palette, inputs have associated labels, and the chat list scrolls correctly. Fix issues found. No behavioural changes.
acceptance_criteria: All pages reviewed at 375px and desktop; layout/focus/contrast issues fixed
Interactive elements show a visible Maersk Blue focus-visible ring; inputs have labels
[MANUAL] Spot-check Home, NewProject, JoinSession, ProjectDashboard, ChatSession at 375px

stories.title: Consistency sweep + Railway-ready build confirmation + docs
stories.description: Final sweep: remove leftover legacy indigo/ad-hoc styles in favour of Maersk tokens/primitives (grep for stray 'indigo' classes), ensure spacing/typography are consistent, and confirm the production build works through the existing Railway pipeline (root build → web build → api serves SPA). Add a short 'Maersk Design refresh' note to a UI section of the project (e.g. apps/web/README.md or CLAUDE.md) describing the palette, fonts, primitives, and that it is a Tailwind replica (no @maersk-global dependency). Do not change Railway config or the API.
acceptance_criteria: grep shows no stray legacy 'indigo-' utility classes left in apps/web/src
Root production build succeeds (npm run build across workspaces) — Railway pipeline unaffected
A short Maersk Design refresh note documents palette/fonts/primitives + 'Tailwind replica, no @maersk-global dep'
